enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping under extra blankets during the cold snap
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the extra blanket over the body. Pull the second blanket up to the chin. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Keep eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Shift the left arm under the pillow. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket back up. Remain lying still. Turn onto the back. Adjust the pillow under the head. Remain lying still with eyes closed until the alarm sounds at 06:15. Reach out the right hand. Press the alarm button to stop it.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower and washing up, scheduled before Member 2's bathroom slot to avoid overlap
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside the bathroom. Turn on the light. Turn on the water heater switch. Turn the shower tap to the hot side. Wait for the water to run warm. Step into the shower. Wet the hair under the water. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the left palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms, chest and legs. Rinse the body. Pick up the washcloth. Wipe the face. Turn the shower tap off. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel from the hook. Rub the hair with the towel. Dry the arms and legs with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Turn off the light. Open the bathroom door. Step out and walk back to Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in warm layers and packing bag for the cold day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a thermal top. Take out a wool sweater. Take out a pair of trousers. Pull the thermal top over the head. Pull the sweater over the thermal top. Pull on the trousers. Pick up a pair of socks from the drawer. Pull the socks onto both feet. Pick up a scarf from the hanger. Wrap the scarf around the neck. Pick up the work bag from the chair. Open the bag zip. Place the laptop into the bag. Place the notebook into the bag. Place the pen into the front pocket. Place the phone into the side pocket. Zip the bag closed. Set the bag down beside the door. Close the wardrobe door. Straighten the blanket on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast of toast and hot tea together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Say to Member 2: 'Morning, kettle's on.' Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Set the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch down. Pick up two slices of bread from the bag. Place the bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Pick up two mugs from the cupboard. Place a tea bag into each mug. Wait for the kettle to click off. Pour hot water into both mugs. Pick up the toast from the toaster. Place the toast on two plates. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down on the chair opposite Member 2. Pick up the mug. Blow on the tea. Drink the tea. Pick up the toast. Bite the toast. Chew and swallow. Drink more tea. Finish the toast. Stand up. Carry the mug and plate to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Final bag check and reviewing today's program notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pick up the work bag from beside the door. Open the bag zip. Look inside the bag. Check the laptop is inside. Check the notebook is inside. Check the pen is in the front pocket. Check the phone is in the side pocket. Pull out the notebook. Open the notebook on the desk. Read the program notes for today. Turn the page. Read the second page of notes. Close the notebook. Place the notebook back into the bag. Zip the bag closed. Pick up the phone. Press the power button. Check the time on the screen. Press the power button. Place the phone into the coat pocket. Pick up the bag. Walk to the door.

Step out of the front door. Pull the door closed. Lock the door with the key. Walk down the front steps. Walk along the pavement to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Pull the scarf tighter around the neck. Put both hands into the coat pockets. Take the phone out. Press the screen to check the bus arrival time. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the travel card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on a vacant seat. Place the bag on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up when the stop is announced. Walk to the exit door. Step off the bus. Walk two blocks to the office building. Push the glass door open. Step into the office. Walk to the desk. Set the bag down beside the chair. Take off the coat. Hang the coat on the hook. Sit down on the chair. Open the bag. Take out the laptop. Place the laptop on the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button.

enriched_activities.activity: Coordinating community programs and meeting partner organisations at the nonprofit office
enriched_activities.desc: Type the login password on the keyboard. Open the email client. Click on the first email. Read the email. Click reply. Type a reply message. Click send. Click on the second email. Read the email. Type a reply message. Click send. Open the program schedule file. Type the new session dates into the spreadsheet. Save the file. Stand up. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down at the meeting table. Shake hands with the visiting partner. Say: 'Thanks for coming in today.' Open the folder on the table. Point to the program timeline page. Discuss the schedule with the partner. Write notes in the notebook. Turn the page. Write further notes. Stand up. Shake hands with the partner. Say: 'I'll send the updated schedule by Friday.' Walk the partner to the door. Push the door open. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Type the meeting notes into a document. Save the document. Pick up the phone. Dial the community centre number. Speak on the phone about the venue booking. End the call. Place the phone on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break with a hot meal nearby
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Push the chair in. Pick up the coat from the hook. Put on the coat. Wrap the scarf around the neck. Walk out of the office. Push the glass door open. Walk along the pavement to the cafe. Push the cafe door open. Step inside. Walk to the counter. Read the menu board. Order a hot soup and a bread roll. Pay with the card at the till. Take the receipt. Walk to a table. Sit down on the chair. Take off the coat. Place the coat on the back of the chair. Pick up the spoon. Stir the soup. Lift the spoon. Eat the soup. Pick up the bread roll. Bite the roll. Chew and swallow. Drink water from the glass. Finish the soup. Stand up. Put on the coat. Pick up the tray. Carry the tray to the return counter. Walk to the door. Push the door open. Walk back to the office.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing program coordination, drafting schedules and replying to community enquiries
enriched_activities.desc: Walk back to the desk. Take off the coat. Hang the coat on the hook. Sit down on the chair. Open the laptop. Type the password. Open the calendar application. Click on the next week block. Type the session times. Drag the workshop block to Thursday. Save the calendar. Open the email inbox. Click on a community enquiry. Read the enquiry. Type a reply. Click send. Open the next enquiry. Read the enquiry. Type a reply with the registration link. Click send. Pick up the phone. Dial the volunteer coordinator. Speak about the volunteer rota for the weekend. End the call. Place the phone on the desk. Open the budget spreadsheet. Type the updated figures into the cells. Save the spreadsheet. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed schedules. Walk back to the desk. Staple the pages together. Place the stapled pages in the folder. Sit down. Open the enquiry log document. Type the details of today's enquiries. Save the document. Close the laptop lid. Stand up. Pick up the bag. Put on the coat. Wrap the scarf around the neck.

Walk out of the office. Pull the door closed. Walk along the pavement to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Pull the scarf up over the chin. Put both hands into the coat pockets. Take the phone out. Check the bus arrival time on the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the travel card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on a vacant seat. Place the bag on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up when the stop is announced. Walk to the exit door. Step off the bus. Walk along the pavement to the house. Walk up the front steps. Take out the key. Unlock the door. Push the door open. Step inside. Close the door behind. Take off the coat. Hang the coat on the hook. Take off the shoes. Place the shoes on the rack. Pick up the bag. Walk to Bedroom 1. Set the bag down beside the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a warm dinner together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Say to Member 2: 'I'll do the vegetables.' Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the tofu. Close the refrigerator door. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Place the pieces into a bowl. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir the vegetables with the spatula. Add the tofu to the pan. Pour in the sauce. Stir the mixture. Turn off the induction cooker. Pick up two bowls from the cupboard. Scoop the food into the bowls. Carry the bowls to the table. Pick up the chopsticks. Sit down on the chair opposite Member 2. Pick up the bowl. Eat the rice. Pick up the vegetables with the chopsticks. Chew and swallow. Drink water from the glass. Finish the meal. Stand up. Carry the bowls to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up dishes and loading the dishwasher together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Squeeze dish soap onto the sponge. Pick up the first plate. Wipe the plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate into the dishwasher rack. Pick up the second plate. Wipe the plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate. Place the plate into the dishwasher rack. Pick up the bowls. Wipe the bowls with the sponge. Rinse the bowls. Place the bowls into the dishwasher rack. Pick up the chopsticks. Wash the chopsticks. Place the chopsticks into the basket. Pick up the pan. Scrub the pan with the sponge. Rinse the pan. Place the pan on the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up a cloth. Wipe the countertop. Say to Member 2: 'I'll close it.' Push the dishwasher door up. Press the start button. Wipe both hands on the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the remote control from the table. Press the power button on the remote. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the cushion. Pull the blanket over the legs. Press the channel button on the remote. Watch the screen. Press the volume button down. Place the remote on the sofa arm. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Press the screen. Scroll through the messages. Put the phone down on the sofa arm. Pick up the remote. Press the channel button. Watch the screen. Pick up the mug from the table. Drink water from the mug. Place the mug back on the table. Press the volume button up. Lean back on the cushion. Watch the screen. Press the power button on the remote. Stand up from the sofa. Fold the blanket. Place the blanket on the sofa arm.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash up and brushing teeth, finished before Member 2's shower slot
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the light. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap between the hands. Rub the soap over the face. Rinse the face with water. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face dry. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush from the cup. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water. Rinse the toothbrush under the tap. Place the toothbrush back into the cup. Turn off the tap. Pick up the hand towel. Wipe both hands. Hang the hand towel on the hook. Turn off the light. Open the bathroom door. Step out. Close the door behind.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and reviewing tomorrow's program notes on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Open the bag. Take out the notebook. Place the notebook on the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Type the login password. Open the program notes document. Scroll down the page. Read the notes. Type additional comments into the document. Save the document. Open the calendar application. Check tomorrow's session times. Close the calendar. Close the document. Pick up the notebook. Open the notebook. Read the handwritten notes. Turn the page. Read the second page. Close the notebook. Place the notebook back into the bag. Close the laptop lid. Stand up. Turn off the desk lamp. Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Sit down on the bed. Lie down. Pull the blanket over the body.

Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Turn onto the right side. Pull the blanket over the shoulder. Keep eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Shift the left arm under the pillow. Turn onto the left side. Pull the blanket back up. Remain lying still. Turn onto the back. Adjust the pillow under the head. Remain lying still with eyes closed until midnight.
